food-xinglong-coffee.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: travel food discovery card, landscape 3:2. Create one elegant editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, distinctly hand-painted rather than a photograph. Accurate, appetizing finished food fills about 75 percent of the frame. Three-quarter overhead composition, lightly textured warm ivory paper and restrained soft wash background, natural daylight, rich food color, fine brushwork and clear silhouettes that remain readable as a small card. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, collage, split panels or extra unrelated dishes. Subject: Xinglong traditional coffee from Hainan: a white ceramic cup and saucer holding freshly brewed very dark brown robusta-style black coffee with a faint wisp of steam, a little spoon resting on the saucer. A simple worn wooden cafe tabletop and soft tropical daylight. Focus tightly on the actual prepared drink; no latte art, no espresso machine, no coffee plantation, no bags or advertising.
